scope: Independent read-only source comparison; no build or remote operation

codec_comparison.region_description: JsonRpcMessageCodec declaration and methods, parsing helpers, Decoder/decode_eof and Encoder before test module

root_cause.changed_component: AsyncRwTransport bounded line reader, not JsonRpcMessageCodec
root_cause.old_behavior: rmcp 3.4.1 read_until returns a nonzero remaining final line at EOF; receive parses and can deliver valid JSON without a trailing LF.
root_cause.new_behavior: rmcp 3.9.0 read_line returns LineRead::Eof whenever fill_buf is empty, even after buffering an unterminated final JSON line; receive returns None.
root_cause.adapter_boundary: The test uses the actual ReaMcpTransport::receive with a Cursor, which delegates to AsyncRwTransport::receive. CapturingReader can finish raw capture at EOF, but attach is invoked only if the SDK produces a message.
root_cause.bom_crlf: BOM removal and CRLF trimming are unchanged inside the byte-identical codec/helper region; the failing input is the second loop case with empty suffix.

accepted_remediation.rationale: Existing adapter contract delegates framing to the SDK. Adopt bounded SDK 3.9 framing explicitly and document the historical behavior change.
accepted_remediation.compatibility_change: A complete JSON final line without LF was accepted in 3.4 and is no longer delivered in 3.9. Senders must terminate STDIO frames with LF.
required_tests: BOM/CRLF and LF positive cases preserve raw key order
Unterminated final EOF case explicitly compares actual SDK and adapter and expects no delivery
Valid over-16-MiB frame is dropped and the next valid frame retains its own raw capture and ordering
Existing 10-MiB raw capture refusal and independent cancellation/ownership assertions remain intact
prohibited_shortcuts: Do not change frozen original response fixtures
Do not replace the production receive test with a standalone codec decode_eof call
Do not inject a virtual LF or disable the SDK 16-MiB limit
Do not skip or retry the failing test as a repair

final_patch_review: Pending validation agent patch; this record binds the root cause and baseline independently.
